text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. 1 O YHWH, in Your strength the king rejoices! And in Your salvation, how greatly he exults!
The desire of his heart You have given to him, and the request of his lips you have not withheld. Selah
for You put before him the blessings of goodness; You set upon his head a crown of pure gold.
Life he has asked from You, [and] You gave [it] to him—length of days, forever and ever.
Great [is] his glory in Your salvation; splendor and majesty You have placed upon him.
For You set [for] him blessings forever; You make him rejoice with gladness before Your face.
For the king trusts in YHWH, and in the loving devotion of the Most High he shall not be shaken.
Your hand will find all Your enemies; Your right hand will find those hating You.
You will place them as [in] a furnace of fire at the time of Your presence; YHWH in His anger will swallow them up, and the fire will devour them.
Their fruit You will destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the sons of men.
For they stretched out against you [for] evil. They devised a plot; they will not prevail.
For You set them [to the] shoulder; You prepare Your bowstrings against their faces.
Be exalted, O YHWH, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your might.
